-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvPb` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem msgPtsC_From_acc [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms :
    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ ∃ p, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"From"
    l) p dq ∗ cellRO p ms.msg.From' ∗ (typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"From" l) p
    dq -∗ msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms)

theorem ownConfChange_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (m : ConfChangeM) :
    ownConfChange p dq m ⊢ |==> ownConfChange p DFrac.discard m

def ccsPts (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfChangeSingleM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt pn uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChangeSingle go!"Type" p) pt dq ∗
          "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt c.Type' ∗
            "HN" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChangeSingle go!"NodeId" p) pn dq ∗
              "#cN" ∷ cellRO pn c.NodeId' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.ConfChangeSingle p uf)

theorem snapOpt_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (o : Option SnapshotM)
    : snapOpt p (dq1 • dq2) o ⊢ snapOpt p dq1 o ∗ snapOpt p dq2 o

theorem needsCap_of_ne {m : MessageM} (h : m.Type' ≠ MsgApp) : needsCap m = false

def entPts (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (e : EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt pi pty ds uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Term" l) pt dq ∗
          "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt e.Term' ∗
            "HI" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Index" l) pi dq ∗
              "#cI" ∷ cellRO pi e.Index' ∗
                "HY" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Type" l) pty dq ∗
                  "#cY" ∷ cellRO pty e.Type' ∗
                    "HD" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Entry go!"Data" l) ds dq ∗
                      "#Hd" ∷ ownSlice ds e.Data' DFrac.discard ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Entry l uf)

theorem ownSnapM_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.Snapshot) (s :
    SnapshotM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSlice v.Data' s.Data' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ smOpt v.Metadata' (DFrac.own 1) s.Metadata' ⊢ |={E}=>
    ownSnapM p (DFrac.own 1) s

def cellRO {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v : V) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null ∧ v = zero_val V⌝ ∨ typedPointsto p v DFrac.discard)

def entRO (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  entPts l DFrac.discard e

def hsRO (p : Loc) (hs : HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt pv pc uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState go!"Term" p) pt DFrac.discard ∗
          "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt hs.Term' ∗
            "HV" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState go!"Vote" p) pv DFrac.discard ∗
              "#cV" ∷ cellRO pv hs.Vote' ∗
                "HC" ∷
                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState go!"Commit" p) pc
                      DFrac.discard ∗
                  "#cC" ∷ cellRO pc hs.Commit' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.HardState p uf)

theorem pbMsg_persistent (T : Type) (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : Persistent (pbMsg T l uf)

def CSLists.Bounded (a : CSLists) : Prop :=
  ↑a.voters.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ↑a.learners.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ↑a.outgoing.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 ∧ ↑a.learnersNext.length ≤ 2 ^ 62

def snapOpt (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) : Option SnapshotM → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some s => ownSnapM p dq s

def msgIn (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (ms : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe (needsCap ms.msg) ms

theorem cellRO_cases {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v : V) : cellRO p v ⊢ ⌜p =
    null ∧ v = zero_val V⌝ ∨ typedPointsto p v DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜p ≠ null⌝

def msgPtsC (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pty pto pfr pte plt pix pco pvo prj prh es els ps cs rs uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HTy" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Type" l) pty dq ∗
          "#cTy" ∷ cellRO pty ms.msg.Type' ∗
            "HTo" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"To" l) pto dq ∗
              "#cTo" ∷ cellRO pto ms.msg.To' ∗
                "HFr" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"From" l) pfr dq ∗
                  "#cFr" ∷ cellRO pfr ms.msg.From' ∗
                    "HTe" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Term" l) pte dq ∗
                      "#cTe" ∷ cellRO pte ms.msg.Term' ∗
                        "HLt" ∷
                            typedPointsto
                              (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"LogTerm" l) plt dq ∗
                          "#cLt" ∷ cellRO plt ms.msg.LogTerm' ∗
                            "HIx" ∷
                                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Index" l) pix
                                  dq ∗
                              "#cIx" ∷ cellRO pix ms.msg.Index' ∗
                                "HCo" ∷
                                    typedPointsto
                                      (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Commit" l) pco dq ∗
                                  "#cCo" ∷ cellRO pco ms.msg.Commit' ∗
                                    "HVo" ∷
                                        typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Vote" l) pvo
                                          dq ∗
                                      "#cVo" ∷ cellRO pvo ms.msg.Vote' ∗
                                        "HRj" ∷
                                            typedPointsto
                                              (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Reject" l)
                                              prj dq ∗
                                          "#cRj" ∷ cellRO prj ms.msg.Reject' ∗
                                            "HRh" ∷
                                                typedPointsto
                                                  (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                    go!"RejectHint" l)
                                                  prh dq ∗
                                              "#cRh" ∷ cellRO prh ms.msg.RejectHint' ∗
                                                "HEs" ∷
                                                    typedPointsto
                                                      (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                        go!"Entries" l)
                                                      es dq ∗
                                                  "Hes" ∷ ownSlice es els dqe ∗
                                                    ("#Hents" ∷ [∗list] p;e ∈ els;ms.ents, entRO p e) ∗
                                                      ("Hes_cap" ∷
                                                          if cap = true then ownSliceCap Loc es (DFrac.own 1) else emp) ∗
                                                        "HSn" ∷
                                                            typedPointsto
                                                              (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                                go!"Snapshot" l)
                                                              ps dq ∗
                                                          "Hsn" ∷ snapOpt ps dq ms.snap ∗
                                                            "HCx" ∷
                                                                typedPointsto
                                                                  (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                                    go!"Context" l)
                                                                  cs dq ∗
                                                              "#Hcs" ∷ ownSlice cs ms.ctx DFrac.discard ∗
                                                                "HRs" ∷
                                                                    typedPointsto
                                                                      (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
                                                                        go!"Responses"
                                                                        l)
                                                                      rs dq ∗
                                                                  "Hrs" ∷ ownSlice rs ms.resps dq ∗
                                                                    "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Message l uf)

theorem msgPtsC_nn [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms : MsgSt)
    : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ ⌜l ≠ null⌝ ∗ msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms

def pbN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"protobuf"

theorem entOwn_freeze [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : entOwn l e ⊢ |==> entRO l
    e

theorem csOptA_nn [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : csOptA p dq
    c ⊢ csOptA p dq c ∗ ⌜p = null ∧ c = { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [],
    LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false } ∨ p ≠ null⌝

structure MsgSt : Type where
  msg : MessageM
  ents : List EntryM
  snap : Option SnapshotM
  ctx : List w8
  resps : List Loc

theorem csOpt_csOptA [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : csOpt p
    dq c ⊢ csOptA p dq c

theorem ownConfChange_persistent (p : Loc) (m : ConfChangeM) : Persistent (ownConfChange p
    DFrac.discard m)

def msgOwn (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ms : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  msgPts l dq DFrac.discard ms

def pbMsg (T : Type) (l : Loc) (uf : List w8) : IProp GF :=
  inv pbN
    iprop(∃ st sc us,
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"state" l) st (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"sizeCache" l) sc
              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            typedPointsto
                (structFieldRef T
                  go!"unknownFields" l)
                us (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              ownSlice us uf (DFrac.own 1))

def ConfChangeM.asV2 (m : ConfChangeM) : ConfChangeV2M :=
  { transition := W32 0, changes := [{ Type' := m.type, NodeId' := m.nodeId }], context := m.context }

theorem ownConfChange_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.ConfChange) (m :
    ConfChangeM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1)
    ∗ cellRO v.Type' m.type ∗ cellRO v.NodeId' m.nodeId ∗ cellRO v.Id' m.id ∗ ownSlice v.Context'
    m.context DFrac.discard ⊢ |={E}=> ownConfChange p (DFrac.own 1) m

theorem csPts_weaken [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al : Bool)
    : csPts p dq c al ⊢ ownCSM p dq c

def csOpt (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null ∧
          c = { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [], LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false }⌝ ∨
      ownCSM p dq c)

theorem smOpt_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM)
    : smOpt p (dq1 • dq2) md ⊢ smOpt p dq1 md ∗ smOpt p dq2 md

theorem cellRO_null {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] : ⊢ cellRO null (zero_val V)

def ownConfChangeV2 (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (m : ConfChangeV2M) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt chs ls cs uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HT" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChangeV2 go!"Transition" p)
              pt dq ∗
          "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt m.transition ∗
            "HCh" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChangeV2 go!"Changes" p) chs
                  dq ∗
              "Hch" ∷ ownSlice chs ls dq ∗
                ("#Hccs" ∷ [∗list] q;c ∈ ls;m.changes, ccsRO q c) ∗
                  "HC" ∷
                      typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChangeV2 go!"Context" p) cs dq ∗
                    "#Hcs" ∷ ownSlice cs m.context DFrac.discard ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.ConfChangeV2 p uf)

def ownConfChangeI (c : GoInterface) (dq : DFrac) : Option ConfChangeIM → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜c = GoInterface.nil⌝)
  | some (ConfChangeIM.v1 m) =>
    iprop(∃ p, ⌜c = interface.mkOk raftpb.ConfChange.ty.PointerType (intoVal p)⌝ ∗ ownConfChange p dq m)
  | some (ConfChangeIM.v2 m) =>
    iprop(∃ p, ⌜c = interface.mkOk raftpb.ConfChangeV2.ty.PointerType (intoVal p)⌝ ∗ ownConfChangeV2 p dq m)

def entOwn (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  entPts l (DFrac.own 1) e

def msgPts (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (ms : MsgSt) : IProp GF :=
  msgPtsC l dq dqe false ms

theorem ccsRO_persistent (p : Loc) (c : ConfChangeSingleM) : Persistent (ccsRO p c)

theorem csPts_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.ConfState) (c :
    ConfStateM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSlice v.Voters' c.Voters' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice v.Learners' c.Learners' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSlice v.VotersOutgoing' c.VotersOutgoing' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice v.LearnersNext'
    c.LearnersNext' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.AutoLeave' c.AutoLeave' ⊢ |={E}=> csPts p (DFrac.own 1)
    c (decide (v.AutoLeave' ≠ null))

theorem csPts_of_struct_ro [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.ConfState) (c :
    ConfStateM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSlice v.Voters' c.Voters' DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice v.Learners' c.Learners' DFrac.discard ∗
    ownSlice v.VotersOutgoing' c.VotersOutgoing' DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice v.LearnersNext'
    c.LearnersNext' DFrac.discard ∗ cellRO v.AutoLeave' c.AutoLeave' ⊢ |={E}=> csPts p DFrac.discard
    c (decide (v.AutoLeave' ≠ null))

def csPts (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sv sl so sn pa,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HV" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState go!"Voters" p) sv dq ∗
          "Hv" ∷ ownSlice sv c.Voters' dq ∗
            "HL" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState go!"Learners" p)
                  sl dq ∗
              "Hl" ∷ ownSlice sl c.Learners' dq ∗
                "HO" ∷
                    typedPointsto
                      (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState
                        go!"VotersOutgoing"
                        p)
                      so dq ∗
                  "Ho" ∷ ownSlice so c.VotersOutgoing' dq ∗
                    "HN" ∷
                        typedPointsto
                          (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState
                            go!"LearnersNext" p)
                          sn dq ∗
                      "Hn" ∷ ownSlice sn c.LearnersNext' dq ∗
                        "HA" ∷
                            typedPointsto
                              (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfState
                                go!"AutoLeave" p)
                              pa dq ∗
                          "#cA" ∷ cellRO pa c.AutoLeave' ∗
                            "%Hal" ∷ ⌜al = true → pa ≠ null⌝ ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.ConfState p [])

theorem sorted_perm_eq (xs ys : List w64) : xs.Perm ys → List.Pairwise (fun a b => uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z
    b) xs → List.Pairwise (fun a b => uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z b) ys → xs = ys

def CSLists.Perm (a b : CSLists) : Prop :=
  a.voters.Perm b.voters ∧ a.learners.Perm b.learners ∧ a.outgoing.Perm b.outgoing ∧ a.learnersNext.Perm b.learnersNext

theorem csPts_nn [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al : Bool) :
    csPts p dq c al ⊢ csPts p dq c al ∗ ⌜p ≠ null⌝

theorem sortedW64_iff_pairwise (xs : List w64) : SortedW64 xs ↔ List.Pairwise (fun a b => uint.Z a ≤
    uint.Z b) xs

theorem needsCap_of_eq {m : MessageM} (h : m.Type' = MsgApp) : needsCap m = true

theorem smPts_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.SnapshotMetadata) (md :
    SnapshotMetadataM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ csOpt v.ConfState' (DFrac.own 1) md.ConfState' ∗ cellRO v.Index' md.Index' ∗
    cellRO v.Term' md.Term' ⊢ |={E}=> smPts p (DFrac.own 1) md

theorem cellRO_persistent {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v : V) : Persistent
    (cellRO p v)

theorem csPts_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al :
    Bool) : csPts p (dq1 • dq2) c al ⊢ csPts p dq1 c al ∗ csPts p dq2 c al

theorem hsRO_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.HardState) (hs :
    HardStateM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    cellRO v.Term' hs.Term' ∗ cellRO v.Vote' hs.Vote' ∗ cellRO v.Commit' hs.Commit' ⊢ |={E}=> hsRO p
    hs

theorem ownConfChangeV2_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.ConfChangeV2) (m
    : ConfChangeV2M) (ls : List Loc) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) :
    typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Transition' m.transition ∗ ownSlice v.Changes' ls
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ([∗list] q;c ∈ ls;m.changes, ccsRO q c) ∗ ownSlice v.Context' m.context
    DFrac.discard ⊢ |={E}=> ownConfChangeV2 p (DFrac.own 1) m

theorem smPts_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM)
    : smPts p (dq1 • dq2) md ⊢ smPts p dq1 md ∗ smPts p dq2 md

theorem hsRO_persistent (p : Loc) (hs : HardStateM) : Persistent (hsRO p hs)

theorem pbMsg_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (T : Type) (l : Loc) (st :
    google_golang_org.protobuf.internal.impl.MessageState) (sc : w32) (us : GoSlice) (uf : List w8)
    (E : CoPset) : typedPointsto (structFieldRef T go!"state" l) st (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef T go!"sizeCache" l) sc (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef T
    go!"unknownFields" l) us (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownSlice us uf (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> pbMsg T l uf

def ownConfChange (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (m : ConfChangeM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pt pn pi cs uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChange go!"Type" p) pt dq ∗
          "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt m.type ∗
            "HN" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChange go!"NodeId" p) pn dq ∗
              "#cN" ∷ cellRO pn m.nodeId ∗
                "HI" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChange go!"Id" p) pi dq ∗
                  "#cI" ∷ cellRO pi m.id ∗
                    "HC" ∷
                        typedPointsto
                          (structFieldRef raftpb.ConfChange go!"Context" p) cs dq ∗
                      "#Hcs" ∷ ownSlice cs m.context DFrac.discard ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.ConfChange p uf)

def SortedW64 (xs : List w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (xi xj : w64), xs[i]? = some xi → xs[j]? = some xj → i < j → uint.Z xi ≤ uint.Z xj

def ccsRO (p : Loc) (c : ConfChangeSingleM) : IProp GF :=
  ccsPts p DFrac.discard c

theorem cellRO_agree {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v1 v2 : V) : cellRO p v1 ∗
    cellRO p v2 ⊢ ⌜v1 = v2⌝

def smOpt (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null ∧
          md =
            {
              ConfState' :=
                { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [], LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false },
              Index' := W64 0, Term' := W64 0 }⌝ ∨
      smPts p dq md)

theorem w64_eq_of_le_le {a b : w64} (h1 : uint.Z a ≤ uint.Z b) (h2 : uint.Z b ≤ uint.Z a) : a = b

theorem csPts_persistent (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) (al : Bool) : Persistent (csPts p DFrac.discard
    c al)

theorem cellRO_alloc {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p : Loc) (v : V) : typedPointsto p v
    (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |==> cellRO p v

theorem entRO_persistent (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : Persistent (entRO l e)

def needsCap (m : MessageM) : Bool :=
  decide (m.Type' = MsgApp)

theorem entOwn_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (v : raftpb.Entry) (e : EntryM) (E :
    CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Term'
    e.Term' ∗ cellRO v.Index' e.Index' ∗ cellRO v.Type' e.Type' ∗ ownSlice v.Data' e.Data'
    DFrac.discard ⊢ |={E}=> entOwn l e

theorem msgOwn_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (ms : MsgSt) : msgOwn l
    (dq1 • dq2) ms ⊢ msgOwn l dq1 ms ∗ msgOwn l dq2 ms

theorem ownSnapM_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (sn : SnapshotM) :
    ownSnapM p (dq1 • dq2) sn ⊢ ownSnapM p dq1 sn ∗ ownSnapM p dq2 sn

theorem ccsRO_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.ConfChangeSingle) (c :
    ConfChangeSingleM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Type' c.Type' ∗ cellRO v.NodeId' c.NodeId' ⊢ |={E}=> ccsRO p c

def csOptA (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null ∧
          c = { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [], LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false }⌝ ∨
      csPts p dq c false ∨ csPts p DFrac.discard c true)

def ownCSM (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : IProp GF :=
  csPts p dq c false

def ConfStateM.lists (c : ConfStateM) : CSLists :=
  { voters := c.Voters', learners := c.Learners', outgoing := c.VotersOutgoing', learnersNext := c.LearnersNext' }

def ownSnapM (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ds pm uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HD" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Data" p) ds dq ∗
          "Hd" ∷ ownSlice ds s.Data' dq ∗
            "HM" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Metadata" p) pm
                  dq ∗
              "Hm" ∷ smOpt pm dq s.Metadata' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot p uf)

theorem csOptA_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) :
    csOptA p (dq1 • dq2) c ⊢ csOptA p dq1 c ∗ csOptA p dq2 c

def smPts (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pc pi pt uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HC" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"ConfState" p) pc
              dq ∗
          "Hc" ∷ csOptA pc dq md.ConfState' ∗
            "HI" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Index" p) pi dq ∗
              "#cI" ∷ cellRO pi md.Index' ∗
                "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Term" p) pt dq ∗
                  "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt md.Term' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.SnapshotMetadata p uf)
